Maharashtra CM States 76% of Closed Companies Were Defunct

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis stated that 76% of the 36,211 companies classified as closed in the state were actually defunct, meaning they were never operational. He presented this data to defend the state's industrial record. The coverage indicates this information was presented in response to some form of opposition claim or criticism regarding company closures in Maharashtra.
